title: Profile a CSV
author: TriunaLabs
origin: Original starter authored for this public library; not copied from installed skills.
requirements: Python 3.10+ for the standard-library analyzer; read access to the CSV. HTML reports run in a modern browser with JavaScript enabled. Optional Laya semantic review requires Node.js 20+, @receptron/laya 0.1.2, about 1.7 GB for model weights, and about 2 GB of memory.
examples: Generate an interactive HTML quality report for this CSV and show me the nulls, type conflicts, duplicates, category variants, and outliers.
Create a Markdown profile of this CSV without including raw row values.
Profile this CSV, then use Laya in shadow mode to suggest semantic column roles and review priorities from aggregate statistics only.
